decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be removed and the land re-instated to 
its former state as grassland no later than 31 December 2019 or when the building(s) is first permanently vacated.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1897-01 Rev C, 1897-02 Rev C, 1897-03, 1897-04, P001 Rev A, P100 Rev A, P101 Rev A, P102 Rev A, P103 Rev A, Design and Access Statement (February 2017; Rev P2) prepared by HNW Architects, Planning Statement (February 2017) prepared by Barton Willmore LLP, Heritage Statement (February 2017) prepared by Heritage Collective. Received: 22/02/2017. Temporary Classrooms Landscape Plan prepared by Terrafirma, Lighting Scheme prepared by Urbis Schreder. Received: 23/03/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
description: Installation of temporary teaching accommodation including provision of additional hardstanding, landscape works, cycle parking, a temporary extension to the access steps to the rear of Busch House School and installation of a temporary platform lift (application for Listed Building Consent)
